test_assert_series_equal: test that two polars Series are equal with configurable dtype, name, and order checking
test_assert_series_not_equal: test that two polars Series are not equal and raise AssertionError if they match
test_assert_series_with_tolerance: test float Series equality with relative and absolute tolerance for inexact comparison
test_assert_series_categorical_as_str: test categorical Series comparison by casting to string before asserting equality
test_assert_series_check_dtypes: test that polars Series have matching data types when check_dtypes is enabled
